proposal.reason: Main change is removing CollNet runtime transport/plugin/proxy execution paths and collective-network wiring (`network`). Also removes CollNet device kernel specializations and function-table entries (`kernels`), deletes CollNet topology graph construction/connection/search behavior (`graph-search`), updates host planning/pattern/channel scheduling and fallback handling after CollNet path removal (`enqueue`), compacts internal algorithm IDs and rewrites built-in cost/default-selection tables accordingly (`tuning`), and adds explicit v1 external tuner-ID translation/fallback at the ABI boundary while keeping plugin v1 compatibility (`tuner-plugin`).
